label: early-input j (and v) in original phase
explanation: Reset-gate unit 2 fires almost only during the original-input phase, when the input token is j (71% of activation mass; activation rate 17.5x baseline) or v (12%), and it is strongest early in the sequence. It never fires at t=0 or t=1 or anywhere in the copy phase. Its rate peaks at t=2 to 3 and falls off steeply by t=5 and later. The largest activations (about 0.9-1.0 of max) are j at t=3, often right after a repeated j or after n. Weaker, smaller tails come from e, k, and 3 inputs and from <DEL> at short sequences (t=3 or 4, 8% of mass). It is roughly silent on all other tokens. Precision is limited because a j late in the sequence (t=5 or later) usually does not fire. first_tok also modulates the firing rate: 0, m, d, and w as first tokens raise it.
